programme.title: டெசர்ட் டைனோசர்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker showcases the biological ingenuity of desert animals that helps them survive in the Namib, one of the harshest places on Earth
programme.desc: பூமியின் மிகக் கடுமையான இடங்களில் ஒன்றான நமீப் பாலைவனத்தில், விலங்குகள் உயிர்வாழ உதவும் உயிரியல் திறன்களைப் பற்றிய ஒரு ஆவணப்படம்.

programme.title: வர்ல்ட்'ஸ் வைல்டெஸ்ட்
programme.desc: World's Wildest.

programme.title: சிபெல்லா - த மிராக்கிள் சீட்டா
programme.sub-title: Sibella, a wild cheetah in South Africa, has a near-death experience. Later, after being rescued and brought to Samara, she rises to become one of the most skilled hunters
programme.desc: ஆபத்திலிருந்து சமாராவுக்கு மீட்டு செல்லப்படும் தென்னாப்பிரிக்க சிறுத்தை சிபெல்லா, சிறந்த வேட்டையாடும் மிருகமாகிறது.

programme.title: அமெரிக்கா'ஸ் வைல்ட் சீஸன்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Across the continent, the land and its wildlife breathe in warmth and renewal. For some animals, courtship rituals begin to heat up as battles for dominance break out. For others, it's the time to tend to brand-new life
programme.desc: வட அமெரிக்காவின் வன விலங்குகள் மற்றும் அதன் மாறிவரும் பருவங்களுக்கு அவை எவ்வாறு அனுசரித்து வாழ்கின்றன என்பதை பற்றி அறிக.

programme.title: மெடிட்டரேனியன் ஹண்டர்ஸ்
programme.desc: Mediterranean Hunters.

programme.title: அனிமல் அட்டாக் ரேட்
programme.sub-title: Discovers wildlife with complex biological weapons in South America, including dangerous creatures living in the Amazon Rainforest
programme.desc: பல்வேறு விலங்குகளின் தாக்கும் உள்ளுணர்வும் அவற்றின் தனித்துவமான அம்சங்களைப் பற்றிய நுண்ணறிவையும் விளக்கும் ஆவணப்படம்.

programme.title: மெடிட்டரேனியன் ஹண்டர்ஸ்
programme.desc: Mediterranean Hunters.

programme.title: வுல்வ்ஸ் \u0026 லயன்ஸ்: ஓல்ட் எனிமீஸ்
programme.sub-title: In Africa, lions and wolves lead their ecosystems. Discover the strength, social strategies and hierarchies behind how they raise and protect their young
programme.desc: நாயினங்களும் பூனையினங்களும் உலகளாவிய மேலாதிக்கத்திற்காக மோதுகின்றன, ஒவ்வொரு பிரதேசத்தையும் யார் ஆட்சி செய்கிறார்கள் என்பதை அவர்களின் வலிமையும் புத்தியும் தீர்மானிக்கின்றன.

programme.title: வர்ல்ட்'ஸ் வைல்டெஸ்ட்
programme.desc: World's Wildest.

programme.title: வைல்ட் கேட்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Sheds light on the wild cats of Africa's numerous challenges and how they adapt to thrive in their environment
programme.desc: மிகவும் சவாலான சில பகுதிகளில் உயிர்வாழ்வதற்காகப் போராட தங்கள் திறன்களைப் பயன்படுத்தும் தீய காட்டு பூனைகளின் பல இனங்கள்.

programme.title: டைகர் மாஃபியா
programme.desc: Tiger Mafia.

programme.title: லா விடா என் எல் ஆஃப்ரிக்கா ஆர்டெண்ட்
programme.sub-title: Being thin, having black patches on light-coloured fur, hyperventilating and licking itself regularly to evaporate saliva are the cheetah's most effective tricks to cope with its scorching environment
programme.desc: உலகின் வெப்பமான பகுதிகளில் ஏற்படும் காலநிலை மாற்றம், மாறிவரும் சூழலுக்கு விலங்குகள் தங்களை மாற்றிக் கொள்வதை பற்றி அறிக.

programme.title: த ஸ்ட்ராங்கெஸ்ட் ஆஃப் த சவண்ணா
programme.desc: The Strongest Of The Savannah.

programme.title: வைல்ட் வைல்ட் பன்ச்
programme.sub-title: Experts analyse the methods that animal delinquents use to create fear and chaos
programme.desc: பல வனவிலங்குகளின் நடத்தை மற்றும் உடல் அம்சங்கள் மற்றும் அவற்றின் இரையைத் தக்கவைக்க பயன்படுத்தும் உத்திகள் பற்றி அறிக.

programme.title: லெப்பர்ட் டைனாஸ்டி: தி ரைஸ் ஆஃப் ராணா
programme.sub-title: In India's Jhalana Reserve, strength, strategy and survival collide in a wild power struggle. Ageing leopard Bahadur rules until his son, Rana, challenges his dominance. As father and son clash, alliances form, and a new chapter begins
programme.desc: இந்தியாவின் ஜாலானா சரணாலயத்தில், ஆளும் வயதான சிறுத்தை பகதூரின் அதிகாரத்திற்கு அதன் மகன் ராணா சவால் விடுகிறான். தந்தை மகனுக்கு இடையிலான இந்த அதிகார மோதலில் வலிமை, வியூகம் மற்றும் உயிர்வாழும் உள்ளுணர்வுகள் தீவிரமடைகின்றன.

programme.title: அனிமல் ஆர்மரி
programme.sub-title: The electric catfish and electric ray use shocks to attack their victims, while elephants and kangaroos fight with their feet
programme.desc: காடுகளில் உள்ள விலங்கினங்கள் எவ்வாறு தாக்க, பாதுகாக்க மற்றும் வேட்டையாட இயற்கை ஆயுதங்களைக் கொண்டுள்ளன.

programme.title: வைல்ட் கிங்டம்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Rivers are the lifeblood Africa's arid landscapes. But while they offer sustenance, the kings of the water take no prisoners here
programme.desc: இயற்கையின் கடுமைகளைத் தாங்கி, பரந்த நிலப்பரப்புகளில் வாழும் வலிமையான விலங்குகளை ஆவணப்படுத்த உலகம் முழுவதும் பயணிக்கிறது.

programme.title: லயன் க்வீன்ஸ்: ஃபைட்டிக் ஃபார் சர்வைவல்
programme.sub-title: Every year in Tanzania, the dry season hits the Ruaha reserve hard. To survive, animal populations come down from the high plateaus to reach the Ruaha river, where a troupe of lionesses waits patiently, poised for combat
programme.desc: தங்கள் நிலத்தை மற்ற காட்டு விலங்குகளுடன் பகிர வேண்டிய சூழ்நிலையில் ருஹாவின் சிங்கங்கள் புதிய உத்திகளை பயன்படுத்துகின்றன.

programme.title: ஹிஸ்டரி ஆஃப் லைஃப் ஆன் எர்த்
programme.sub-title: It took a long time for vertebrates to really take over the land, but once they did, there was no turning back. Reptiles seemed to win the race, some becoming the biggest creatures to ever walk the Earth
programme.desc: Exploring how life began and evolved on planet Earth.

programme.sub-title: It took a long time for vertebrates to really take over the land, but once they did, there was no turning back. Reptiles seemed to win the race, some becoming the biggest creatures to ever walk the Earth
programme.desc: Exploring how life began and evolved on planet Earth.

programme.title: டெசர்ட் டைனோசர்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker showcases the biological ingenuity of desert animals that helps them survive in the Namib, one of the harshest places on Earth
programme.desc: பூமியின் மிகக் கடுமையான இடங்களில் ஒன்றான நமீப் பாலைவனத்தில், விலங்குகள் உயிர்வாழ உதவும் உயிரியல் திறன்களைப் பற்றிய ஒரு ஆவணப்படம்.

programme.title: ஆன் த ட்ரெய்ல் ஆஃப் ஸ்னோ லெப்பர்ட்
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker delves into the search for snow leopards and records the experiences of experts who witness the rare sight of these animals moving around in rocky landscapes
programme.desc: பனி சிறுத்தைகளை தேடி, பாறை நிலப்பரப்புகளில் அவை நடமாடும் அரிய காட்சியை காணும் நிபுணர்களின் அனுபவங்களை அறியும் இயக்குனர்.

programme.title: வைல்ட் கிங்டம்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Rivers are the lifeblood Africa's arid landscapes. But while they offer sustenance, the kings of the water take no prisoners here
programme.desc: இயற்கையின் கடுமைகளைத் தாங்கி, பரந்த நிலப்பரப்புகளில் வாழும் வலிமையான விலங்குகளை ஆவணப்படுத்த உலகம் முழுவதும் பயணிக்கிறது.

programme.title: டைகர் ஆன் தி ரன்
programme.sub-title: Follow a young tiger in India that has been forced out of its home territory by another male and has to struggle for survival
programme.desc: தனது பிரதேசத்திலிருந்து வலுக்கட்டாயமாக வெளியேற்றப்பட்டபின்பு, தனது தன்னம்பிக்கையால் பெரிய புலியாகும் ஆண் புலி குமால்.

programme.title: வைல்ட் கேட்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Explores the daily activities of predatory wild cats residing in the forests of America while capturing their unseen intimacy with their families
programme.desc: மிகவும் சவாலான சில பகுதிகளில் உயிர்வாழ்வதற்காகப் போராட தங்கள் திறன்களைப் பயன்படுத்தும் தீய காட்டு பூனைகளின் பல இனங்கள்.

programme.title: த க்விக் அண்ட் த ஸ்லோ
programme.sub-title: Hitting the gas with hawks, cheetahs, and other speed demons to learn why first-in-class acceleration can be an evolutionary advantage, then pumping the brakes with Earth's biggest slowpokes to see why, sometimes, slow and steady wins the race
programme.desc: விலங்குகளுடைய வேகங்களின் ஸ்பெக்ட்ரம் மற்றும் இந்த மாறுபட்ட நடத்தைகளை வடிவமைக்கும் சுற்றுச்சூழல் காரணிகள் குறித்து அறிக.

programme.title: ஸ்ரீலங்கா - லெப்பர்ட்ஸ் ஆஃப் யாலா
programme.sub-title: Follow the trials and tribulations of a group of leopards in Yala National Park
programme.desc: இலங்கையின் யாலா தேசிய பூங்காவில் வாழும் சிறுத்தைகளின் நடத்தை, உயிர்வாழும் உத்திகள் மற்றும் சவால்களை ஆராயும் இயக்குனர்.

programme.title: விங்க்ஸ் ஓவர் வாட்டர்
programme.desc: Wings Over Water.

programme.title: பீஹார் கி ராமாயணா யாத்ரா
programme.desc: Bihar KI Ramayana Yatra.

programme.title: பீஹார் கி ராமாயணா யாத்ரா
programme.desc: Bihar KI Ramayana Yatra.

programme.title: தி வியூ ஃப்ரம் ஆன் ஹை
programme.sub-title: Exploring how the meticulously planned architectural features of Saint Petersburg were constructed, with a particular focus on their sacral meanings
programme.desc: ரஷ்யாவின் இரண்டாவது பெரிய நகரமான செயின்ட் பீட்டர்ஸ்பர்க்கில் உள்ள நினைவுச் சின்னங்கள் மற்றும் கட்டிடங்களின் வரலாறு மற்றும் கட்டிடக்கலையை பற்றி விளக்கும் ஒரு ஆவணப்படம்.

programme.title: ஏர் ஜாஸ்: ரெட், ஒயிட் அண்ட் ப்ரீச்
programme.desc: Reports and video evidence of flying great whites off the California coast spark a mission to capture the new phenomenon on film and determine if Air Jaws has taken flight in America.

programme.title: மைண்ட் வைல்ட்
programme.sub-title: Has a look at how animals build shelters that are more complicated than simple nests
programme.desc: இயற்கையான வாழ்விடங்களில் வனவிலங்குகளின் உயிர்வாழும் நடத்தைகள் மூலம் அவற்றின் அறிவின் தன்மையை ஆராயும் நிபுணர்கள்.

programme.title: பிக் கேட்ஸ்: அன் அமேசிங் அனிமல் ஃபேமிலி
programme.sub-title: As Patrick Aryee delves into the feline family tree, the biologist witnesses gravity-defying 'catrobatics', tests the speed of a cheetah, and explores the odd-looking Pallas's cat
programme.desc: காடுகளில் ஆதிக்கம் செலுத்தும் 37 வகையான வேட்டை பூனைகளின் வெற்றியையும், அவற்றின் குடும்ப மரத்தையும் பற்றிய ஒரு ஆவணப்படம்.

programme.title: அட்டன்பரோ'ஸ் லைஃப் இன் கலர்
programme.sub-title: The crew shares how they captured views of a hidden world across various habitats and challenging conditions using a pioneering camera system
programme.desc: David Attenborough explores the vital role that colour plays in the daily life of various species. For us humans, it is a source of aesthetic beauty and expression, but for animals it is an essential tool used for survival and without it, there would be catastrophic consequences. Colours help animals to win a mate, to fight off rivals and to warn enemies. Attenborough explores nature's use of colour using technological advancements in camera equipment to reveal the world, as seen by animals.

programme.title: பேட்டல் ஆஃப் த அல்ஃபாஸ்
programme.sub-title: Madagascar is home to strange animals not found anywhere else on Earth. When these animals fight for supremacy, their battles are just as strange -- from weird neck-wrestling weevils to ring-tailed lemur mums that go into battle with baby on board

programme.title: சர்வைவிங்க் அர்த்
programme.sub-title: A protective mother amphibian battles to keep her brood of eggs in water while the forest around her dries out and the trees collapse
programme.desc: An eight-part docuseries exploring Earth's major eras and extinction events across 450 million years alongside the creatures who fought to survive.

programme.title: வுல்வ்ஸ் \u0026 லயன்ஸ்: ஓல்ட் எனிமீஸ்
programme.sub-title: Felines and canids clash across the world. Dive into direct battles and strategies to steal food. Intelligence and strength decide who reigns in each territory
programme.desc: நாயினங்களும் பூனையினங்களும் உலகளாவிய மேலாதிக்கத்திற்காக மோதுகின்றன, ஒவ்வொரு பிரதேசத்தையும் யார் ஆட்சி செய்கிறார்கள் என்பதை அவர்களின் வலிமையும் புத்தியும் தீர்மானிக்கின்றன.

programme.title: மெடிட்டரேனியன் ஹண்டர்ஸ்
programme.desc: Mediterranean Hunters.

programme.title: லா விடா என் எல் ஆஃப்ரிக்கா ஆர்டெண்ட்
programme.sub-title: Many species that live in extreme places slow down their cycles of reproduction and breeding. Wild dogs speed up the process by several weeks to avoid having to expose their pups to the dangers of heat
programme.desc: உலகின் வெப்பமான பகுதிகளில் ஏற்படும் காலநிலை மாற்றம், மாறிவரும் சூழலுக்கு விலங்குகள் தங்களை மாற்றிக் கொள்வதை பற்றி அறிக.

programme.title: ஹிஸ்டரி ஆஃப் லைஃப் ஆன் எர்த்
programme.sub-title: The first life forms on the planet were microscopic, single-celled organisms; it took billions of years before more complex creatures evolved, first jelly-like bodies, and then armoured shells on their outsides, and finally the first backbone
programme.desc: Exploring how life began and evolved on planet Earth.

programme.title: வைல்ட் வைல்ட் பன்ச்
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker offers insights into the diverse behaviours, survival strategies and hunting tactics of various wildlife
programme.desc: பல வனவிலங்குகளின் நடத்தை மற்றும் உடல் அம்சங்கள் மற்றும் அவற்றின் இரையைத் தக்கவைக்க பயன்படுத்தும் உத்திகள் பற்றி அறிக.

programme.title: வாலி ஆஃப் ஃப்ளட் அண்ட் ஃபயர்
programme.sub-title: It's the end of November in the Luangwa Valley, and the rains have just begun. It marks the end of one of the toughest dry seasons on record, and triggers a transition from parched wilderness to luscious wetland
programme.desc: பசுமையான தாவரங்களால் நிறைந்த ஒரு செழிப்பான சுற்றுச்சூழல் அமைப்பாக மாற்றும் லுவாங்வா பள்ளத்தாக்கின் பருவகால மாற்றங்கள்.

programme.title: சீட்டா: தி மாசாய் பிரதர்ஹுட்
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker sheds light on the Tana Bora, an alliance of five cheetahs who have grown into a formidable hunting unit that takes down large prey and survives super predators of the savannah
programme.desc: சவானாவின் பெரிய இரைகளை வீழ்த்தி, ஒரு வலிமையான வேட்டைக் குழுவாக வளர்ந்த ஐந்து சிறுத்தைகளின் டானா போரா பற்றிய ஆவணப்படம்.

programme.title: க்ளோரியஸ் க்ராஸ்லேண்ட்ஸ்
programme.desc: Like a sea of grass, the savannah, prairie and meadows are among the most productive habitats on Earth, housing some of the greatest concentrations of big game and dramatic interactions between predator and prey.

programme.title: வைல்ட் பேட்டல்கிரவுண்ட்
programme.sub-title: Animals face challenges when trying to survive in some of the driest, fieriest places on the planet, battling exhaustion and dehydration
programme.desc: பல வேட்டையாடும் விலங்குகளின் தனித்துவமான பண்புகள் மற்றும் அவற்றின் உயிர்வாழும் உள்ளுணர்வு குறித்து ஆராயும் இயக்குனர்.

programme.title: ஹிப்போஸ் ஆஃப்டர் டார்க்

programme.title: శివ
programme.sub-title: Shiva is a brave and intelligent child who stays with his grandparents in Vedas City. He sets out with his gang of friends to save the citizens from all sorts of evil
programme.desc: వేదాస్ నగరంలో తన బామ్మాతాతాలతో నివసించే ధైర్యంగల శివ, మిత్రులతో కలిసి తన నగరాన్ని దుష్ట శక్తుల నుండి కాపాడాలనుకుంటాడు.

credits.actor: Nilufer Middey,Sonal Kaushal,Rupa Bhimani,Anamay Verma,Aditya Jaiswal,Brij Bhushan Sawhney,Manoj Pandey

programme.sub-title: There is a constant war between Doggy Don and the three clever mice who live in his house. However, with the help of Doggy Don's brother, an ex-army dog, they fight the mice to win back their house
programme.desc: తన ఇంట్లో మూడు ఎలుకలతో నిరంతరం యుద్ధం చేసే డాగీ డాన్, మాజీ ఆర్మీ కుక్కతో కలిసి తమ ఇంటిని సొంతం చేసుకోడానికి పోరాడతాడు.

programme.desc: एक विषय विशेषज्ञ शिक्षक प्रशिक्षण पाठ्यक्रम के भाग के रूप में ई-लर्निंग की बुनियादी अवधारणाओं पर विस्तृत और आसान तरीके से जानकारी प्रदान करते हैं।.

programme.title: कम्पोनेंट्स ऑफ फील्डवर्क इन एमएसडबल्यू प्रोग्राम एमए
programme.sub-title: A subject-matter expert provides a comprehensive lecture on various concepts pertaining to the components of fieldwork in MSW programme in an easy-to-understand manner
programme.desc: एक विषय विशेषज्ञ, एमएसडब्ल्यू प्रोग्राम में फील्डवर्क के घटकों से संबंधित विभिन्न अवधारणाओं पर विस्तृत व्याख्यान प्रदान करते हैं।.

programme.title: अनुवाद और साहित्य
programme.sub-title: A language expert presents an introduction to translation and literature and highlights some of the most important topics that are covered under these two fields
programme.desc: एक भाषा विशेषज्ञ अनुवाद और साहित्य का परिचय प्रस्तुत करते हैं और इन दो क्षेत्रों के अंतर्गत आने वाले कुछ सबसे महत्वपूर्ण विषयों के बारे में बताते हैं।.

programme.title: दास्तान-ए-मर्सिया कर्बला से काशी तक
programme.sub-title: An expert delivers an explanation and provides information on poetry, explaining its various aspects in a detailed manner
programme.desc: विशेषज्ञ कविता के बारे में विस्तृत व्याख्या और जानकारी प्रदान करते हैं और इसके विभिन्न पहलुओं को विस्तृत तरीके से समझाते हैं।.

programme.title: इंट्रोडक्शन टू बीपीओ
programme.sub-title: A subject-matter expert delivers a detailed lecture on business process outsourcing in a brief, simple and easy-to-understand manner
programme.desc: एक विषय विशेषज्ञ संक्षिप्त, सरल और आसान तरीके से बिजनेस प्रोसेस आउटसोर्सिंग पर विस्तृत व्याख्यान प्रस्तुत करते हैं।.

programme.title: क्रिटिकल कल्चरल थियोरिज एण्ड मीडिया सोसाइटी थियोरिज
programme.sub-title: A subject-matter expert delivers an informative lecture on critical cultural theories and media society theories with the help of appropriate illustrations and examples
programme.desc: एक विषय विशेषज्ञ उचित दृष्टांतों और उदाहरणों की मदद से महत्वपूर्ण सांस्कृतिक सिद्धांतों और मीडिया समाज सिद्धांतों पर जानकारीपूर्ण व्याख्यान प्रस्तुत करते हैं।.

programme.title: मेटाडेटा स्टैंडर्ड्स एण्ड इंटरोऑपरेबिलिटी
programme.sub-title: An expert discusses the concepts of metadata standards and interoperability and proceeds to compare and contrast the two themes
programme.desc: एक विशेषज्ञ, मेटाडेटा मानकों और अंतर-संचालनीयता की अवधारणाओं पर चर्चा करते हैं तथा दोनों विषयों की तुलना और अन्तर समझाते हैं।.

programme.title: डायबिटीज मेलाइटस अ साइलेंट किलर
programme.sub-title: A professor invites a scientist to discuss Diabetes mellitus, a metabolic disease and explains its symptoms, causes, prevention and treatment to help students understand it in layman's terms

programme.title: बालिका वधू - कक़ची उमर के पक्के रिश्ते
programme.sub-title: Anandi, a child bride, married into an affluent family at a tender age, struggles to cope with the traditions. Soon, she overcomes multiple personal obstacles to emerge as an example for rural women
programme.desc: कम उम्र में एक संपन्न परिवार में शादी होने के बाद आनंदी परंपराओं से तालमेल बिठाने के लिए संघर्ष करती है। जल्द ही, वह कई व्यक्तिगत बाधाओं को पार कर ग्रामीण महिलाओं के लिए एक उदाहरण बनती है।.

programme.desc: Japanese design is world-famous, but not because it's expensive, stylish or modern. It's because excellent design exists within the tools and habits of everyday life. Leading creators visit different parts of the country to hear unfamiliar stories.

programme.title: Kabuki Kool
programme.desc: The historic figure of Minamoto no Yoshitsune has been immortalised in many kabuki plays as a child, a skilled warrior, and a tragic hero. Explore with actor Kataoka Ainosuke.

credits.actor: Kataoka Ainosuke,Sarah Álainn,Nakamura Kazutaro I,Haruka Christine

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: Hourly news updates featuring current affairs, business news, financial updates and global weather forecasts.

programme.title: Documentary 360
programme.desc: Featuring documentaries that shed light on politics, the economy, social trends, science and the environment in Japan and beyond.

programme.title: यजमान
programme.sub-title: Devi Shetty, a cruel gangster, is out to plunder a village's oil resources and ruin its inhabitants' livelihood. However, the son-in-law of the village head, Krishna, stands in his way
programme.desc: एक गाँव के मुखिया का दामाद कृष्णा, क्रूर गैंगस्टर देवी शेट्टी का सबसे बड़ा दुश्मन बन जाता है, जब वह गाँव के तेल संसाधनों को लूटने और ग्रामीणों की आजीविका को बर्बाद करने का फैसला करता है।.

credits.actor: Darshan Thoogudeepa,Rashmika Mandanna,Dhananjaya,Devaraj,Tanya Hope,Sadhu Kokila,Thakur Anoop Singh,Sharath Lohitashwa,Manjunath Hegde,Sanju Basayya,Mandya Ramesh

programme.title: आज का नया खिलाड़ी
programme.sub-title: Siva unknowingly crosses a ruthless gangster while robbing the Home Minister's residence. Subsequently, the gangster kidnaps the Minister's daughter in retribution
programme.desc: गृह मंत्री के घर में चोरी करते समय शिवा अनजाने में एक बेरहम गैंगस्टर से टकरा जाता है। इसके बाद, वह गैंगस्टर बदला लेने के लिए मिनिस्टर की बेटी का अपहरण कर लेता है।.

credits.actor: Nitin,Ileana D'Cruz,Ahuti Prasad,Shawar Ali,Mohammad Ali,Raghu Babu,Sarathbabu,Tanikella Bharani

programme.title: राजू कन्नड़ मीडियम
programme.sub-title: Raju, a village boy, travels to Bengaluru in search of a better job. Along the way, he faces numerous challenges that teach him valuable life lessons
programme.desc: एक महत्वाकांक्षी ग्रामीण लड़का अपने सपनों को पूरा करने के लिए बेंगलुरु जाता है। वह शहर में बहुत सी चुनौतियों का अनुभव करता है जो उसकी जीवन के कुछ मूल्यवान सबक सीखने में मदद करती हैं।.

programme.title: खतरनाक खिलाड़ी
programme.sub-title: A humble vegetable vendor protects an old woman and her two young daughters. Soon, an incident involving a couple of thugs unveils his true identity
programme.desc: एक सीधा-सादा सब्ज़ीवाला एक बुज़ुर्ग महिला और उसकी दो छोटी बेटियों की रक्षा करता है। जल्द ही, कुछ गुंडों से जुड़ी एक घटना उसकी असली पहचान सबके सामने ले आती है।.

programme.title: सिपाही
programme.sub-title: In his quest to expose illegal activities in his city, a journalist finds himself pitted against a formidable gangster who threatens to derail his crusade for justice
programme.desc: अपने शहर में अवैध गतिविधियों को उजागर करने की कोशिश में, एक पत्रकार खुद को एक दुर्जेय गैंगस्टर के खिलाफ खड़ा पाता है, जो न्याय के लिए उसके अभियान को बर्बाद करने की धमकी देता है।.

programme.title: मधगजा

programme.title: पेट्टा
programme.sub-title: In a bid to save his best friend's son Anwar, hostel warden Kaali goes against local goons. However, everything goes haywire when he is forced to face his past
programme.desc: अपने सबसे अच्छे दोस्त के बेटे अनवर को बचाने के लिए हॉस्टल वार्डन काली स्थानीय गुंडों के खिलाफ जाता है। हालाँकि, जब उसे अपने अतीत का सामना करना पड़ता है तब सब कुछ गड़बड़ हो जाता है।.

programme.desc: सीनू बड़ी ही चतुराई से अपनी जगह अपने हमशक्ल को जेल में अपनी जगह नियुक्त कर जेल से फ़रार हो जाता है। जब उसे शंकर के नेक मिशन के बारे में पता चलता है तो वह उसे पूरा करने की ज़िम्मेदारी खुद पर लेता है।.

programme.title: ఛోటా భీమ్
programme.sub-title: Bheem is an extremely brave, strong and intelligent young boy. He often manages to solve everyone's problems which endears him to the townspeople of Dholakpur
programme.desc: చాలా ధైర్యవంతుడు, బలమైన, తెలివైన బాలుడు భీమ్, ఢోలక్‌పూర్‌ పట్టణవాసుల సమస్యలన్నింటినీ పరిష్కరించగలుగుతాడు.

credits.actor: Vatsal Dubey (Chhota Bheem),Julie Tejwani (Raju),Rupa Bhimani (Chutki),Sabina Malik Mausam (Kalia),Rajesh Kava (Jaggu),Prince Patel (Takiya)

programme.title: లిటిల్ కృష్ణ మెడ్లీస్
programme.sub-title: Little Krishna has fun getting caught up in all sorts of mischief with his friends in Vrindavan. But when the evil Kansa sends his minions to disrupt his life, he jumps into action
programme.desc: బృందావనంలో తన స్నేహితులతో కలిసి అల్లరి చేస్తూ సరదాగా తిరిగే శ్రీకృష్ణుడు, కంసుడి రాక్షసులను అంతం చేయడానికి సిద్దమవుతాడు.

programme.title: లిటిల్ కృష్ణ
programme.sub-title: Little Krishna, a mischievous child, lives in the village of Vrindavan. He decides to save the villagers from an evil king, Kamsa, who sends ferocious demons upon them
programme.desc: కొంటెవాడైన చిన్ని కృష్ణుడు, ప్రజలపైకి భయంకర రాక్షసులను పంపిన దుష్ట కంసుడి నుండి బృందావన ప్రజలను కాపాడాలనుకుంటాడు.

credits.actor: Prachi Save Saathi,Meghna Erande,Neil D'Monte,Anand Tiwari,Vikrant Chaturvedi,Soniya Nair,Cara Pareira

programme.title: చోటా భీమ్ దామ్యాన్ కా బద్లా
programme.sub-title: Chhota Bheem, a gifted nine-year-old boy, and his friends set out to fight evil in the city of Sonapur and defeat Damyaan, a demon blessed with immortality
programme.desc: తొమ్మిదేళ్ల ఛోటాభీమ్, అతడి మిత్రులు సోనాపూర్ నగరంలో చెడుతో, అమరుడైన దమ్యాన్ అనే రాక్షసుడిని ఓడించడానికి సిద్ధమవుతారు.

programme.title: లిటిల్ సింగం ఔర్ కృష్ణ: జోడీ మే హై దమ్
programme.sub-title: The unbeatable duo, Little Singham and Krishna, have to overcome various challenges in order to beat the evil and mighty Kans
programme.desc: అజేయమైన జోడీ అయిన లిటిల్ సింగం, కృష్ణలు దుర్మార్గుడు, శక్తివంతుడైన కంసుడిని ఓడించడానికి అనేక సవాళ్ళను ఎదుర్కొంటారు.

programme.title: లిటిల్ సింగం ఔర్ కృష్ణ జోడి నంబర్ 1
programme.sub-title: Kans, a malevolent force, descends on Earth to sow chaos. But hope rises as Little Singham and Krishna unite, ready to confront the evil force and protect the world
programme.desc: భూమిపై వినాశనం సృష్టించడానికి పన్నాగం పన్నుతున్న దుష్ట కంసుడిని ఎదుర్కోవడానికి లిటిల్ సింగం, కృష్ణ జతకడతారు.

programme.title: గ్రిజ్జీ అండ్ ద లెమ్మింగ్స్
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house
programme.desc: గ్రిజ్జీ అనే ఎలుగుబంటి ఒక అటవీ రేంజర్ ఇంటిని తన సొంత నివాసంగా భావిస్తుంది, అయితే లెమ్మింగ్స్ రాకతో పరిస్థితి మారుతుంది.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.sub-title: Grizzy and the Lemmings embark on an exciting adventure across the world, while causing chaos in each other's lives on their tour

programme.title: లిటిల్ సింగం: అంధేర్ హవా సే ముకాబ్లా
programme.sub-title: Little Singham must protect the Hachi artefacts from a dangerous tribe called Andher Hawa and its ferocious leader, Nakoa
programme.desc: లిటిల్ సింగం, 'అంధేర్ హవా' అనే ప్రమాదకర గిరిజనతెగ నుండి, దాని క్రూరమైన నాయకుడు 'నకోవా' నుండి 'హాచి' కళాఖండాలను కాపాడాలి.

programme.title: లిటిల్ సింగం అండ్ బ్లాక్ షాడో: సూపర్ స్పై గేమ్స్
programme.sub-title: Little Singham and Black Shadow get kidnapped and are forced to compete in various missions and challenges along with other agents of the Super Spy Games
programme.desc: లిటిల్ సింగం తన స్నేహితులతో కలిసి, మానవాళిని నాశనం చేయాలనుకునే దుష్ట శక్తులను ఓడించడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తాడు.

programme.title: ఛోటా భీమ్
programme.sub-title: Bheem is an extremely brave, strong and intelligent young boy. He often manages to solve everyone's problems which endears him to the townspeople of Dholakpur
programme.desc: చాలా ధైర్యవంతుడు, బలమైన, తెలివైన బాలుడు భీమ్, ఢోలక్‌పూర్‌ పట్టణవాసుల సమస్యలన్నింటినీ పరిష్కరించగలుగుతాడు.

credits.actor: Vatsal Dubey (Chhota Bheem),Julie Tejwani (Raju),Rupa Bhimani (Chutki),Sabina Malik Mausam (Kalia),Rajesh Kava (Jaggu),Prince Patel (Takiya)

programme.title: స్మాషింగ్ సింబా
programme.sub-title: Simmba, an honest and courageous police officer, teams up with his fearless colleagues in his mission to confront and defeat the evil forces of society
programme.desc: నిజాయితీగల, ధైర్యవంతుడైన పోలీసు అధికారి సింబా, తన సహచరులతో కలిసి సమాజంలోని దుష్ట శక్తులను ఎదుర్కొవాలనుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: గ్రిజ్జీ అండ్ ద లెమ్మింగ్స్
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house
programme.desc: గ్రిజ్జీ అనే ఎలుగుబంటి ఒక అటవీ రేంజర్ ఇంటిని తన సొంత నివాసంగా భావిస్తుంది, అయితే లెమ్మింగ్స్ రాకతో పరిస్థితి మారుతుంది.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.title: Life of Kai
programme.sub-title: Kai Lenny kicks off the big wave season at Jaws, facing the risks that come with his pursuit of progression, then Maui water safety bands together after fires ravage the town of Lahaina
programme.desc: Ride shotgun with Kai Lenny as he redefines what's possible in the world's biggest waves, chasing his dreams to become the ultimate waterman.

programme.title: Premier Padel Highlights
programme.sub-title: Watch the action from Mexico as the world's best padel players tackle the Cancun Premier Padel P2
programme.desc: Highlights, replays and more of Premier Padel Tennis tournaments from around the world.

programme.title: Against Gravity - Leon Glatzer sucht die besten Wellen
programme.desc: We accompany German professional surfer and Olympian Leon Glatzer. He takes us to the best and most challenging surf spots around the world and performs manoeuvres on the waves.

programme.title: My Name is João Chianca
programme.desc: From the highs of qualifying to the lows of unlucky losses, Brazilian surfing's next big thing, João Chianca, is quickly learning about the highs and lows of life on the WSL Championship Tour.

programme.title: Cycling Around the World
programme.sub-title: In the ride of a lifetime, Payson McElveen makes cycling history as the first person to complete a human-powered journey across the rugged interior of Iceland, covering 257 miles in just one day
programme.desc: From Bali to Scotland, joining Danny MacAskill, Rebecca Rusch, Tom Oehler, Daniel Wedemeijer and more on a two-wheeled adventure around the globe as they explore the world on bikes.

programme.title: Red Bull Rampage
programme.sub-title: A dozen female mountain bike athletes compete in this invitation-only freeride event. After creating their own lines in the red-rock landscape of Utah, watch them showcase their skill and creativity
programme.desc: An invitation-only freeride mountain bike competition held near Zion National Park in Virgin, Utah.

programme.title: Saya Sakakibara: Ride to Redemption
programme.desc: BMX racer Saya Sakakibara takes a soul-searching journey into her Japanese heritage, where the principles of Kintsugi and Yuimaru guide her path to healing, self-discovery and triumphant comeback.

programme.title: Resilience: The Els Visser Story
programme.desc: How does surviving a ship wreck lead to someone becoming a successful triathlete? Learn about Els Visser's journey from medical student to sporting success via a life-threatening disaster at sea.

programme.title: WRC: More Than Machine
programme.sub-title: Carrying the weight of expectation of one of the most historic rally teams, Malcolm and the M-Sport crew are determined to make a mid-year impact in Portugal and Sardinia
programme.desc: Series following members of the M-Sport WRC team about the trials and tribulations of competing in Rally driving at the highest level.

programme.title: Life of Kai
programme.sub-title: Surf brothers Kai and Ridge Lenny relive their epic XXL wave ride at Maui's Jaws surf spot, and Kai lets us go BTS to have a look at his state-of-the-art surf equipment testing
programme.desc: Ride shotgun with Kai Lenny as he redefines what's possible in the world's biggest waves, chasing his dreams to become the ultimate waterman.

programme.title: Reel Rock
programme.sub-title: Siebe Vanhee recruits his childhood heroes, Sean Villanueva O'Driscoll and Nico Favresse, to attempt the first free ascent of an alpine big wall in Patagonia, Argentina
programme.desc: Follows the world's top climbers, alpinists and mountaineers to the wildest places on Earth. New stories of triumph, failure and redemption unfold as they pursue the thrill of adventure.

programme.title: Beyond the ROX
programme.sub-title: After years of training, Jake Dearden reaches the Elite 15. Now he faces the world's best. Can he prove he belongs in the 2024/25 season?
programme.desc: The best HYROX athletes uncover what it takes to rise to the top.

programme.title: MTB RAW
programme.sub-title: To become one of the world's best MTB slopestyle riders it takes a dedication to training in the right conditions. Step inside Matt Jones' secret compound to find out what it takes to beat the best
programme.desc: See what happens when the talent and creativity of filmmakers and MTB athletes is combined. A special kind of magic emerges, including incredible riding with ground-breaking filmmaking for the ultimate two-wheeled rush.

programme.title: Reel Rock
programme.desc: Follows the world's top climbers, alpinists and mountaineers to the wildest places on Earth. New stories of triumph, failure and redemption unfold as they pursue the thrill of adventure.

programme.title: Poetic Silence - Discovering Indonesian Waves
programme.desc: Follows top women surfers as they spend an extraordinary time together in the Mentawai Islands in the late 90s, discovering perfect waves in an Indonesian paradise.

programme.title: My Name is João Chianca
programme.desc: From the highs of qualifying to the lows of unlucky losses, Brazilian surfing's next big thing, João Chianca, is quickly learning about the highs and lows of life on the WSL Championship Tour.

programme.title: No Contest: Off Tour
programme.sub-title: From the Eastern Suburbs to the Central Coast and from The Shire to the Northern Beaches, meet the colourful characters and explore the surfing culture of Australia's biggest city, Sydney
programme.desc: Exploring the communities of surfing's international hot zones. Includes a look at Italy, Fiji, urban surf cities like NYC and Tel Aviv, and the jungles of Central America and South Brazil.

programme.title: The Modus Mix - Evolution of Women's Surfing
programme.desc: Follow established and new rising women surfers as they progress the sport during the early 2000s.

programme.title: 444 Days - Aidan Heslop Returns
programme.desc: Former World Series Champion, Aidan Heslop, faces the hardest comeback to reclaim his place at 27m.

programme.title: Here to Climb
programme.desc: Sasha DiGiulian rises from child prodigy to a champion sport climber, as she ultimately makes her mark by taking her talents to the biggest walls on the planet with a series of bold, first female ascents.

credits.actor: Sasha DiGiulian,Cedar Wright,Alex Honnold,Lynn Hill,Pablo Durana,Erik Osterholm

programme.title: Nazaré: Making Giants
programme.desc: Nazaré, Portugal, is a small fishing village that's home to the biggest waves in the world.

credits.actor: Pedro Scooby,Kai Lenny,Lucas Chumbo,Rodrigo Koxa,Justine Dupont

programme.title: Nazaré: Making Giants
programme.desc: Lucas Chumbo and Kai Lenny push the boundaries of what's plausible on a big wave.

credits.actor: Pedro Scooby,Kai Lenny,Lucas Chumbo,Rodrigo Koxa,Justine Dupont

programme.title: Masters of Dirt - Total Freestyle Tour
programme.desc: Dive into the thrilling world. Insane tricks, world records and wild stories await in an unforgettable journey to the heart of extreme sports, motocross, MTB, BMX and much more.

programme.title: Red Bull Cliff Diving World Series
programme.sub-title: A breathtaking venue pushes Morgane Herculano and Jonathan Paredes to question their career choices
programme.desc: Athletes compete to execute acrobatic dives from great heights in the Red Bull Cliff Diving World Series, a major diving tournament.

programme.title: Padel Explained: An Essential Guide
programme.desc: Discover why padel is the fastest-growing sport on the planet in a story told by the players who made history.

credits.actor: Gonzalo Oubiña,Nicolás Quarles Van Ufford,Clara Navarro

programme.title: Red Bull Films
programme.sub-title: Follow Asa Vermette, one of mountain biking's most exciting young riders, on his debut at Red Bull Hardline

programme.title: No Contest: Off Tour
programme.sub-title: While Japan is known for both tradition and technology it's also an archipelago lashed by swell and steeped in surfing culture. Kanoa Igarashi takes you to Tokyo to get a taste of the action
programme.desc: Exploring the communities of surfing's international hot zones. Includes a look at Italy, Fiji, urban surf cities like NYC and Tel Aviv, and the jungles of Central America and South Brazil.

programme.title: Cycling

programme.title: True to This

programme.title: WRC: More Than Machine

programme.title: Mountain Biking

programme.title: Natural Heights

programme.title: Material Witness
programme.desc: The FBI suspects' fraudulent business practices are linked to the mysterious disappearance of Candor Diamond Corporation president, Irwin Margolies. Weeks after Margolies turns up, and begins cooperating with authorities, several Candor employees are now the victims of brutal murders. The deaths all point to the work of a hired hit man, with possible links to Margolies, but it will take the concentrated efforts of federal agents to untangle the web of clues to convict the killers.

credits.actor: Mark Joy (Donald Nash),Carl Burrows,Keith Michael Gregory,Michael McKennitt,Tim L. Smith

programme.title: Monsters and Mysteries
programme.desc: Whether the protagonist is a Batsquatch, Skunk Ape, Mothman or Chupacabra, tales of mysterious creatures and unexplainable phenomena have been passed down generations. \"Monsters and Mysteries in America\" takes a trip across the U.S. to reveal the most cryptic, frightening and brow-furrowing stories. Each hourlong episode focuses on a specific region and the lore of residents who claim to have encountered legendary monsters, ancient spirits or alien beings. With America's dense forests, desert grasslands, and hundreds of miles of uninhabitable wilderness, could it really house -- or hide -- so many mysterious creatures?

programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: टेलीविजन के सर्वश्रेष्ठ कार्यक्रमों की प्रस्तुति।.

programme.title: बब्लू डबलू
programme.sub-title: An evil logger decides to turn the forest into his personal lumberyard. However, things change after Bablu and Dablu, two bear brothers, decide to stop him
programme.desc: एक दुष्ट लकड़हारा जंगल को अपना निजी लकड़हारा बनाने का फ़ैसला करता है। लेकिन, दो भालू भाइयों, बबलू और डबलू, द्वारा उसे रोकने के फ़ैसले के बाद चीज़ें बदल जाती हैं।.

programme.title: हनी बनी
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: टेलीविजन के सर्वश्रेष्ठ कार्यक्रमों की प्रस्तुति।.

programme.title: जंगल बुक
programme.sub-title: Mowgli, a young boy, is raised in the jungle by wolves. He has two loyal friends, Bagheera, a panther, and Baloo, a bear, who safeguard him from Shere Khan, a Bengal tiger, who wants to devour Mowgli
programme.desc: एक छोटा लड़का मोगली, जंगल में भेड़ियों के बीच पला-बढ़ा है। उसके दो वफादार दोस्त हैं, बघीरा (एक तेंदुआ), और बल्लू (एक भालू), जो उसे शेर खान (एक बंगाल टाइगर) से बचाते हैं, जो मोगली को खाना चाहता है।.

programme.title: 12 ज्योतिर्लिंग दर्शन
programme.sub-title: Devotees come together to participate in a pilgrimage to visit the 12 Jyotirlingas, which are considered a divine manifestation of Lord Shiva
programme.desc: भक्तगण 12 ज्योतिर्लिंगों के दर्शन हेतु तीर्थयात्रा में भाग लेने के लिए एकत्रित होते हैं, जिन्हें भगवान शिव का दिव्य स्वरूप माना जाता है।.

programme.title: धर्म कथा
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the teachings of the Almighty and encourages followers to take the path of spirituality
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, ईश्वर की शिक्षाओं पर प्रकाश डालते हैं और अनुयायियों को आध्यात्मिकता का मार्ग अपनाने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।.

programme.title: भक्ति प्रवाह
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of ancient hymns and spiritual verses chanted in order to praise the Almighty is played back to back
programme.desc: यह कार्यक्रम, परमेश्वर की स्तुति के लिए संगीतबद्ध किए गए प्राचीन भजनों और आध्यात्मिक छंदों का व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।.

programme.title: भूत बॉस (पाप-ओ-मीटर)
programme.sub-title: Bhoot Boss, Thakela and Pakela are ghosts who seek out people that have sinned and teach them a lesson to reduce wrongdoings in the world. However, their mission lands them in precarious situations
programme.desc: भूत बॉस, थकेला और पकेला भूत हैं जो पाप करने वाले लोगों को ढूंढ उन्हें सबक सिखाते हैं। हालांकि, उनका मिशन उन्हें अनिश्चित परिस्थितियों में डाल देता है।.

programme.title: जानबाज़ मुर्गा
programme.sub-title: A fun-loving chicken along with his friends embark on various adventures, as they overcome challenges and share heartfelt moments
programme.desc: एक मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला मुर्गा अपने दोस्तों के साथ विभिन्न साहसिक कार्यों पर निकलता है, जहां वे चुनौतियों पर विजय प्राप्त करते हैं और दिल को छू लेने वाले पल साझा करते हैं।.

programme.title: हनी बनी
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: टेलीविजन के सर्वश्रेष्ठ कार्यक्रमों की प्रस्तुति।.

programme.title: जंगल बुक
programme.sub-title: Mowgli, a young boy, is raised in the jungle by wolves. He has two loyal friends, Bagheera, a panther, and Baloo, a bear, who safeguard him from Shere Khan, a Bengal tiger, who wants to devour Mowgli
programme.desc: एक छोटा लड़का मोगली, जंगल में भेड़ियों के बीच पला-बढ़ा है। उसके दो वफादार दोस्त हैं, बघीरा (एक तेंदुआ), और बल्लू (एक भालू), जो उसे शेर खान (एक बंगाल टाइगर) से बचाते हैं, जो मोगली को खाना चाहता है।.

programme.title: बब्लू डबलू
programme.sub-title: An evil logger decides to turn the forest into his personal lumberyard. However, things change after Bablu and Dablu, two bear brothers, decide to stop him
programme.desc: एक दुष्ट लकड़हारा जंगल को अपना निजी लकड़हारा बनाने का फ़ैसला करता है। लेकिन, दो भालू भाइयों, बबलू और डबलू, द्वारा उसे रोकने के फ़ैसले के बाद चीज़ें बदल जाती हैं।.

programme.title: बब्लू डबलू
programme.sub-title: An evil logger decides to turn the forest into his personal lumberyard. However, things change after Bablu and Dablu, two bear brothers, decide to stop him
programme.desc: एक दुष्ट लकड़हारा जंगल को अपना निजी लकड़हारा बनाने का फ़ैसला करता है। लेकिन, दो भालू भाइयों, बबलू और डबलू, द्वारा उसे रोकने के फ़ैसले के बाद चीज़ें बदल जाती हैं।.

programme.title: यस बॉस
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: टेलीविजन के सर्वश्रेष्ठ कार्येक्रम।.

programme.title: जीजा जी छत पर है
programme.sub-title: Elaichi's mischievous antics keep her father Murari on edge, while Pancham, secretly in love with her, navigates hilarious mishaps due to his hidden marital status
programme.desc: इलायची की शरारतें उसके पिता मुरारी को परेशान रखती हैं, जबकि पंचम, जो मन ही मन इलायची से प्यार करता है, अपनी छुपी हुई वैवाहिक स्थिति के कारण हास्यास्पद घटनाओं से गुजरता है।.

credits.actor: Hiba Nawab,Nikhil Khurana,Anup Upadhyay,Soma Rathod,Harveer Singh,Raashi Bawa,Firoz Khan,Naveen Bawa,Saheb Das Manikpuri

programme.title: मद्दाम सर
programme.sub-title: Four brave female police officers of Aminabad police station use their wittiness and emotional intelligence to tackle the various challenges they face at their work
programme.desc: अमीनाबाद पुलिस स्टेशन की चार बहादुर महिला पुलिस अधिकारी अपने कार्यस्थल की विभिन्न चुनौतियों से निपटने के लिए अपनी बुद्धिमता और भावनात्मक बुद्धिमत्ता का उपयोग करती हैं।.

credits.actor: Bhavika Sharma (Santosh \"Santu\" Sharma),Gulki Joshi (Haseena Mallik),Sonali Pandit Naik (Pushpa Singh),Yukti Kapoor (Karishma Singh),Rahil Azam (Anubhav Singh),Ajay Jadhav (Billu Champat),Yashkant Sharma (Cheteshwar \"Cheetah\" Chaturvedi),Priyanshu Singh (Cheteshwar \"Cheetah\" Chaturvedi)

programme.sub-title: After Baron Alwyn's men set fire to the palace of the Huntingtons, young Robert, along with his friend and sisters, seeks refuge in Sherwood Forest. There, they meet the leader of a group of outlaws
programme.desc: बैरन एल्विन के आदमियों द्वारा हंटिंगटन के महल में आग लगाने के बाद, रॉबर्ट अपने दोस्त और बहनों के साथ शेरवुड फ़ॉरेस्ट में शरण लेता है। वहाँ, वे डाकूओं के एक समूह के नेता से मिलते हैं।.

programme.title: हनी बनी
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: टेलीविजन के सर्वश्रेष्ठ कार्यक्रमों की प्रस्तुति।.

programme.title: जंगल बुक
programme.sub-title: Mowgli, a young boy, is raised in the jungle by wolves. He has two loyal friends, Bagheera, a panther, and Baloo, a bear, who safeguard him from Shere Khan, a Bengal tiger, who wants to devour Mowgli
programme.desc: एक छोटा लड़का मोगली, जंगल में भेड़ियों के बीच पला-बढ़ा है। उसके दो वफादार दोस्त हैं, बघीरा (एक तेंदुआ), और बल्लू (एक भालू), जो उसे शेर खान (एक बंगाल टाइगर) से बचाते हैं, जो मोगली को खाना चाहता है।.

programme.title: भूत बॉस (पाप-ओ-मीटर)
programme.sub-title: Bhoot Boss, Thakela and Pakela are ghosts who seek out people that have sinned and teach them a lesson to reduce wrongdoings in the world. However, their mission lands them in precarious situations
programme.desc: भूत बॉस, थकेला और पकेला भूत हैं जो पाप करने वाले लोगों को ढूंढ उन्हें सबक सिखाते हैं। हालांकि, उनका मिशन उन्हें अनिश्चित परिस्थितियों में डाल देता है।.

programme.title: बब्लू डबलू
programme.sub-title: An evil logger decides to turn the forest into his personal lumberyard. However, things change after Bablu and Dablu, two bear brothers, decide to stop him
programme.desc: एक दुष्ट लकड़हारा जंगल को अपना निजी लकड़हारा बनाने का फ़ैसला करता है। लेकिन, दो भालू भाइयों, बबलू और डबलू, द्वारा उसे रोकने के फ़ैसले के बाद चीज़ें बदल जाती हैं।.

programme.title: 12 ज्योतिर्लिंग दर्शन
programme.sub-title: Devotees come together to participate in a pilgrimage to visit the 12 Jyotirlingas, which are considered a divine manifestation of Lord Shiva
programme.desc: भक्तगण 12 ज्योतिर्लिंगों के दर्शन हेतु तीर्थयात्रा में भाग लेने के लिए एकत्रित होते हैं, जिन्हें भगवान शिव का दिव्य स्वरूप माना जाता है।.

programme.title: धर्म कथा
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the teachings of the Almighty and encourages followers to take the path of spirituality
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, ईश्वर की शिक्षाओं पर प्रकाश डालते हैं और अनुयायियों को आध्यात्मिकता का मार्ग अपनाने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।.

programme.title: भक्ति प्रवाह
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of ancient hymns and spiritual verses chanted in order to praise the Almighty is played back to back
programme.desc: यह कार्यक्रम, परमेश्वर की स्तुति के लिए संगीतबद्ध किए गए प्राचीन भजनों और आध्यात्मिक छंदों का व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।.

programme.title: जांबाज मुर्गा
programme.sub-title: A trio of chickens resides on a lively farm. Meanwhile, two mischievous weasels from a chaotic junkyard plot to make a meal out of them
programme.desc: एक खेत में रहने वाली मुर्गियों की एक तिकड़ी को एक अव्यवस्थित कबाड़खाने में रहने वाले दो शरारती नेवले अपना भोजन बनाने की योजना बनाते हैं।.

programme.desc: भूत बॉस, थकेला और पकेला भूत हैं जो पाप करने वाले लोगों को ढूंढ उन्हें सबक सिखाते हैं। हालांकि, उनका मिशन उन्हें अनिश्चित परिस्थितियों में डाल देता है।.

programme.title: बब्लू डबलू
programme.sub-title: An evil logger decides to turn the forest into his personal lumberyard. However, things change after Bablu and Dablu, two bear brothers, decide to stop him
programme.desc: एक दुष्ट लकड़हारा जंगल को अपना निजी लकड़हारा बनाने का फ़ैसला करता है। लेकिन, दो भालू भाइयों, बबलू और डबलू, द्वारा उसे रोकने के फ़ैसले के बाद चीज़ें बदल जाती हैं।.

programme.title: हनी बनी
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: टेलीविजन के सर्वश्रेष्ठ कार्यक्रमों की प्रस्तुति।.

programme.title: मद्दाम सर
programme.sub-title: Four brave female police officers of Aminabad police station use their wittiness and emotional intelligence to tackle the various challenges they face at their work
programme.desc: अमीनाबाद पुलिस स्टेशन की चार बहादुर महिला पुलिस अधिकारी अपने कार्यस्थल की विभिन्न चुनौतियों से निपटने के लिए अपनी बुद्धिमता और भावनात्मक बुद्धिमत्ता का उपयोग करती हैं।.

programme.title: जीजाजी छत पर हैं
programme.sub-title: Pancham and Pintu disguise themselves as a married couple in a desperate attempt to find a house and succeed in renting Murari's attic. However, Murari's daughter, Elaichi, learns about their secret
programme.desc: पंचम और पिंटू किराए के मकान के लिए मुरारी के सामने पति-पत्नी होने का नाटक करते हैं। हालांकि, मुरारी की बेटी इलायची को उनके रहस्य के बारे में पता चल जाता है।.

programme.title: ஆசை 100 வகை

programme.title: प्यार ही प्यार
programme.sub-title: At an orphanage, Kailashnath identifies Vijay as his biological son and takes him home. Years later, a man named Ashok arrives and claims to be Kailashnath's real son
programme.desc: कैलाशनाथ एक अनाथालय में अपने बेटे विजय को पहचानता है और उसे घर ले आता है। वर्षों बाद, अशोक नाम का एक व्यक्ति, कैलाशनाथ का असली बेटा होने का दावा करता है।.

programme.title: क्रोधी
programme.sub-title: Vicky plans to marry Aarti, but his dreams are crushed when an incident causes her to lose her life. Fuelled by revenge, Vicky finds himself going down a dark path
programme.desc: विक्रमजीत 'विक्की' सिंह एक दुर्भाग्यपूर्ण घटना के बाद गैंगस्टर बन जाता है। वर्षों बाद, एक सीबीआई अधिकारी की पत्नी, नीरा, जो विक्की के लिए काम करती थी, एक साधू से मिलती है, जो गैंगस्टर का हमशक्ल है।.

programme.title: इंटरनेशनल क्रूक
programme.sub-title: Rajesh, the superintendent of the police, is happy to meet his old friend, Shekar, in Goa, unaware that he is a smuggler, who is involved in a spree of illegal activities
programme.desc: एक पुलिस अधीक्षक, राजेश गोवा में अपने पुराने दोस्त, शेखर से मिलता है। लेकिन,उसे शेखर तस्कर है और अवैध गतिविधियों में शामिल हैं, यह जरासा भी पता नही है।.

credits.actor: Dharmendra,Feroz Khan,Saira Banu,Om Prakash,Sulochana Chatterjee,Murad,Jagdish Raj,Jagdeep,Jayshree T.,Sunder

programme.title: अब क्या होगा
programme.sub-title: A young man stumbles upon a mysterious woman, who he suspects of being a ghost. However, his worst fears come true when his mother arranges his marriage with the same woman
programme.desc: एक युवक एक रहस्यमयी महिला से अचानक मिलता है, जिस पर उसे भूत होने का शक होता है। हालाँकि, उसका सबसे बुरा डर तब सच हो जाता है जब उसकी माँ उसकी शादी उसी महिला से तय कर देती है।.

credits.actor: Shatrughan Sinha,Neetu Singh,Asrani,Pinchoo Kapoor,Chand Usmani,Indrani Mukherjee

programme.title: रिक्शावाला
programme.sub-title: Gopi, a humble rickshaw puller, faces love and social prejudice as he pursues a relationship with Kiran, a woman from a higher class, challenging societal norms and personal conflicts
programme.desc: रिक्शाचालक गोपी, सामाजिक मानदंडों और व्यक्तिगत संघर्षों को चुनौती देते हुए उच्च वर्ग की एक महिला किरण के साथ संबंध बनाता है।.

credits.actor: Randhir Kapoor (Gopi),Neetu Singh (Kiran),Pran (Shri Kailash),Anwar Hussain (Madan),Ashoo (Shanti),Sujit Kumar (Manohar),Mala Sinha (ParvatiDevi),Ranjeet Bedi (Murli),Mohan Choti (Kabira)

programme.title: इक्का राजा रानी
programme.sub-title: Talented dancer, Barkha, saves the life of an underground crime boss, VK, who offers her a job as repayment. Later VK falls for Barkha, but she is in love with another man
programme.desc: विक्की,एक खतरनाक डॉन, बरखा को अपना जीवन बचाने के लिए नौकरी प्रदान करता है और उसे उससे प्यार होता है। जब उसे पता चलता है कि वह सागर से प्यार करती है, तो वह उनके बीच गलतफहमी पैदा करता है।.

credits.actor: Tinnu Anand,Ashwini Bhave,Anil Dhawan,Govinda,Ayesha Jhulka,Bharat Kapoor,Tej Sapru,Paresh Rawal

programme.title: जैसी करनी वैसी भरनी
programme.sub-title: A conniving son throws his aged parents out of the house. Years later, he meets the same fate when his son decides to teach him a lesson
programme.desc: एक लालची बेटा, अपने वृद्ध माता पिता को घर से बाहर निकाल देता है। वर्षों बाद, उसका बेटा उसे सबक सिखाने का फैसला करता है और उसे घर के बाहर निकालता है।.

credits.actor: Govinda (Ravi Verma),Kimi Katkar (Radha),Shakti Kapoor (Vijay Verma),Kader Khan (Gangaram Verma),Asrani (Datturam),Gulshan Grover (Ranjeet),Shoma Anand

programme.desc: सिद्धार्थ की परवरिश एकल माँ द्वारा हुई है और वह विदेश में बसना चाहता है। वह संगीत प्रतियोगिता में भाग लेता है, एक लोक-गायिका और सामाजिक कार्यकर्ता, नेहा से प्यार होने पर उसका जीवन बदलता है।.

credits.actor: Mukesh Tiwari,Shrenu Parikh,Shilpa Tulaskar,Abhinav Parashar,Karim Hajee,Kuldeep Sareen,Rajeev Sharma,Arsh Sehrawat

programme.desc: एक कवयित्री को एक अपराधी से प्यार हो जाता है जो एक कवि भी है। उसकी रिहाई के बाद वह उससे अलग होता है और छल के जाल में फंस जाता है।.

credits.actor: Dev Anand (Amar),Hema Malini (Shalini),Pran Sikand (Thakur saab),Bindu Desai (Rani),Madan Puri (Madanlal Dogra),Manmohan Krishna (Jailor),Padma Khanna (Manju)

programme.title: गुलाम-ए-मुस्तफा
programme.sub-title: A notorious hitman forsakes a life of crime after his lady love suffers a tragic death due to his professional rivalries. However, the mafia compels him to return for a final hit job

programme.desc: राजकुमार की माँ को जब पता चलता है कि वह प्रतिद्वंद्वी राज्य की राजकुमारी से शादी करने की योजना बना रहा है, तो वह उसकी शादी का विरोध करने लगती है।.

credits.actor: Naseeruddin Shah,Anil Kapoor,Madhuri Dixit,Danny Denzongpa,Reena Roy,Farida Jalal

programme.title: ज़ुल्मी
programme.sub-title: Raj is hired as a bodyguard for Komal, and the two grow closer to each other over time. However, things get complicated when he comes across Nihal, the man who molested his sister
programme.desc: बलराज, डॉन बाबा ठाकुर के पोते, अनाथ निहाल और उसकी बेटी, कोमल की देखभाल करता है। वह कोमल की रक्षा के लिए एक स्ट्रीट फायटर को नियुक्त करता है, लेकिन यह नहीं जानता कि निहाल और राज दुश्मन हैं।.

credits.actor: Akshay Kumar,Twinkle Khanna,Amrish Puri,Aroona Irani,Dalip Tahil,Deep Dhillon,Arun Bakshi,Dara Singh,Milind Gunaji

programme.title: एस.पी. चौहान
programme.sub-title: Satpal Chauhan, a social worker from Haryana, works for women empowerment and also strives to create an alcohol-free society. However, while pursuing his goals, he faces several hardships
programme.desc: हरियाणा के सामाजिक कार्यकर्ता सतपाल चौहान महिला सशक्तिकरण के लिए काम करते हैं और शराब मुक्त समाज बनाने के लिए भी प्रयासरत हैं। हालाँकि, लक्ष्य का पीछा करते हुए उन्हें कठिनाइयों का सामना करना पड़ता है।.

programme.sub-title: When an ordinary man discovers crores in his account, he is thrown into a tangled mess of crime, impersonation and corrupt connections he never asked for
programme.desc: एक साधारण आदमी को पता चलता है, कि उसके खाते में करोड़ों रुपये जमा हैं, तब वह अपराध, छद्मवेश और भ्रष्ट संबंधों के ऐसे दलदल में फंस जाता है जिसकी उसने कभी कल्पना भी नहीं की थी।.

programme.desc: शांति का पति सूरज, उसे और उसके नवजात बच्चे को छोड़ देता है, और रुचि से शादी करता है, जो एक लड़के को जन्म देती है। जब लड़के बड़े होते है, वें बिना सच जाने एक दूसरे के साथ लड़ाई करते हैं।.

programme.title: विनाशक - डेस्ट्रोयर

programme.title: డెసర్ట్ డైనోసార్స్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker showcases the biological ingenuity of desert animals that helps them survive in the Namib, one of the harshest places on Earth
programme.desc: భూమిపై అత్యంత కఠినమైన ప్రదేశాలలో ఒకటైన నమీబ్‌ ఎడారిలో జంతువులకు తోడ్పడే జీవసంబంధిత నైపుణ్యాన్ని ప్రదర్శిస్తారు.

programme.title: వరల్డ్స్ వైల్డెస్ట్
programme.desc: World's Wildest.

programme.title: సిబెల్లా - ద మిరాకిల్ చీతా
programme.sub-title: Sibella, a wild cheetah in South Africa, has a near-death experience. Later, after being rescued and brought to Samara, she rises to become one of the most skilled hunters
programme.desc: దక్షిణాఫ్రికాలో మరణానికి సమీపంలో ఉన్న సిబెల్లా అనే అడవి చిరుత రక్షించబడిన తర్వాత వేట పద్దతులను నేర్చుకుంటుంది.

programme.title: అమెరికాస్ వైల్డ్ సీజన్స్
programme.sub-title: Across the continent, the land and its wildlife breathe in warmth and renewal. For some animals, courtship rituals begin to heat up as battles for dominance break out. For others, it's the time to tend to brand-new life
programme.desc: ప్రతి సీజన్ లో పర్యావరణంలో వచ్చే అద్భుతమైన పరివర్తనల గురించి తెలుపుతూ, అమెరికాలోని విభిన్న ప్రకృతి దృశ్యాలను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: మెడిటరేనియన్ హంటర్స్
programme.desc: Mediterranean Hunters.

programme.title: యానిమల్ ఎటాక్ రేట్
programme.sub-title: Discovers wildlife with complex biological weapons in South America, including dangerous creatures living in the Amazon Rainforest
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు వివిధ క్రూర జంతువుల దాడి విధానాలు, ప్రవృత్తిని వివరిస్తూ, వాటి విచిత్ర లక్షణాలపై అంతర్దృష్టులను అందిస్తారు.

programme.title: వోల్వ్స్ అండ్ లయన్స్: ఓల్డ్ ఎనిమీస్
programme.sub-title: In Africa, lions and wolves lead their ecosystems. Discover the strength, social strategies and hierarchies behind how they raise and protect their young
programme.desc: కుక్క జాతి జంతువులు, పిల్లి జాతి జంతువుల తెలివితేటలు పోల్చి ఏ జాతి ఒక ప్రాంతాన్ని శాసిస్తుందో తెలుస్తుంది.

programme.title: వరల్డ్స్ వైల్డెస్ట్
programme.desc: World's Wildest.

programme.title: వైల్డ్ క్యాట్స్
programme.sub-title: Sheds light on the wild cats of Africa's numerous challenges and how they adapt to thrive in their environment
programme.desc: క్రూరమైన అడవి పిల్లులు చాలా సవాలుగా ఉన్న ప్రాంతాలలో మనుగడ కోసం పోరాడటానికి తమ అద్భుతమైన నైపుణ్యాలను ఉపయోగిస్తాయి.

programme.title: టైగర్ మాఫియా
programme.desc: Tiger Mafia.

programme.title: లా విడా ఎన్ ఎల్ ఆఫ్రికా ఆర్డియంటే
programme.sub-title: Being thin, having black patches on light-coloured fur, hyperventilating and licking itself regularly to evaporate saliva are the cheetah's most effective tricks to cope with its scorching environment
programme.desc: The threat of climate change is especially a risk for those living in the world's hottest regions, such as the Namib, the Kalahari and the Kaokoveld in the southern cone of Africa.

programme.title: ది స్ట్రాంగెస్ట్ ఆఫ్ ది సవన్నా
programme.desc: The Strongest Of The Savannah.

programme.title: వైల్డ్ వైల్డ్ బంచ్
programme.sub-title: Experts analyse the methods that animal delinquents use to create fear and chaos
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు విభిన్న వన్యప్రాణుల ప్రవర్తనా, భౌతిక కోణాలను అలాగే తమ ఎరను ఓడించడానికి ఉపయోగించే వ్యూహాల గురించి తెలియజేస్తారు.

programme.title: లెపర్డ్ డైనాస్టీ: ది రైజ్ ఆఫ్ రాణా
programme.desc: In India's Jhalana Reserve, strength, strategy and survival collide in a wild power struggle. Ageing leopard Bahadur rules until his son, Rana, challenges his dominance. As father and son clash, alliances form, and a new chapter begins.

programme.title: యానిమల్ ఆర్మరీ
programme.sub-title: The electric catfish and electric ray use shocks to attack their victims, while elephants and kangaroos fight with their feet
programme.desc: Only the strongest survive in the animal kingdom, where the competition for food, territory or mates means employing skilfully crafted tricks of the trade. `Animal Armory' incorporates high-end imagery and computer graphics to reveal how wildlife use their teeth, claws, antlers, camouflage, venom and even spit to threaten and intimidate rivals and predators alike. With weapons of deception, animals disarm and entice prey to their death. Meanwhile, perhaps the oldest weapons employed by animals are projectiles, which have evolved into their own versions of poison-tipped harpoons, chemical missiles and high-powered bullets.

programme.title: వైల్డ్ కింగ్డమ్స్
programme.sub-title: Rivers are the lifeblood Africa's arid landscapes. But while they offer sustenance, the kings of the water take no prisoners here
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు ప్రకృతి కాఠిన్యాన్ని భరించిన, విశాలమైన ప్రకృతి దృశ్యాలలో నివసించే కొన్ని బలమైన జంతువులను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: లయన్ క్వీన్స్: ఫైటింగ్ ఫర్ సర్వైవల్
programme.sub-title: Every year in Tanzania, the dry season hits the Ruaha reserve hard. To survive, animal populations come down from the high plateaus to reach the Ruaha river, where a troupe of lionesses waits patiently, poised for combat
programme.desc: తమ భూభాగంలో నివసించే రుహాలోని ఆడసింహాలు భూమిని ఇతర అడవి జంతువులతో పంచుకోవలసి వచ్చినప్పుడు కొత్త వ్యూహాలు సిద్ధంచేస్తాయి.

programme.title: హిస్టరీ ఆఫ్ లైఫ్ ఆన్ ఎర్త్
programme.sub-title: It took a long time for vertebrates to really take over the land, but once they did, there was no turning back. Reptiles seemed to win the race, some becoming the biggest creatures to ever walk the Earth
programme.desc: Exploring how life began and evolved on planet Earth.

programme.title: బర్త్ ఆఫ్ స్పీడ్

programme.desc: భూమిపై అత్యంత కఠినమైన ప్రదేశాలలో ఒకటైన నమీబ్‌ ఎడారిలో జంతువులకు తోడ్పడే జీవసంబంధిత నైపుణ్యాన్ని ప్రదర్శిస్తారు.

programme.title: బర్త్ ఆఫ్ స్పీడ్
programme.sub-title: Mountains, rocks and steep cliffs, no place for a predator relying on their speed. But that's exactly where we find our two magnificent Cheetah mothers. Hidden between the mountains, open savannah plains miraculously appear. And on these savannahs
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు, తమ పిల్లలను పోషించడానికి, శిక్షణ ఇవ్వడానికి ప్రయత్నించే రెండు తల్లి చిరుతల ప్రయాణాన్ని చూపుతారు.

programme.sub-title: It took a long time for vertebrates to really take over the land, but once they did, there was no turning back. Reptiles seemed to win the race, some becoming the biggest creatures to ever walk the Earth
programme.desc: Exploring how life began and evolved on planet Earth.

programme.title: ఆన్ ద ట్రయల్ ఆఫ్ స్నో లెపర్డ్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker delves into the search for snow leopards and records the experiences of experts who witness the rare sight of these animals moving around in rocky landscapes
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు మంచు చిరుతపులి కోసం అన్వేషిస్తూ, ఈ జంతువులు తిరిగే అరుదైన దృశ్యాన్ని చూసే నిపుణుల అనుభవాలను రికార్డు చేస్తారు.

programme.title: వైల్డ్ కింగ్డమ్స్
programme.sub-title: Rivers are the lifeblood Africa's arid landscapes. But while they offer sustenance, the kings of the water take no prisoners here
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు ప్రకృతి కాఠిన్యాన్ని భరించిన, విశాలమైన ప్రకృతి దృశ్యాలలో నివసించే కొన్ని బలమైన జంతువులను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: టైగర్ ఆన్ ది రన్
programme.sub-title: Follow a young tiger in India that has been forced out of its home territory by another male and has to struggle for survival
programme.desc: తన భూభాగం నుండి బయటికి వెళ్ళిపోయినా చిన్న మగ పులి కుమాల్, అడవిలో జీవిస్తూ, ఎలా పెరిగి, పెద్దదయ్యిందో చూడండి.

programme.title: వైల్డ్ క్యాట్స్
programme.sub-title: Explores the daily activities of predatory wild cats residing in the forests of America while capturing their unseen intimacy with their families
programme.desc: క్రూరమైన అడవి పిల్లులు చాలా సవాలుగా ఉన్న ప్రాంతాలలో మనుగడ కోసం పోరాడటానికి తమ అద్భుతమైన నైపుణ్యాలను ఉపయోగిస్తాయి.

programme.title: ది క్విక్ అండ్ ది స్లో
programme.sub-title: Hitting the gas with hawks, cheetahs, and other speed demons to learn why first-in-class acceleration can be an evolutionary advantage, then pumping the brakes with Earth's biggest slowpokes to see why, sometimes, slow and steady wins the race
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు జంతువుల వేగాల వర్ణపటాన్ని పరిశీలిస్తూ, ఈ విరుద్ధమైన ప్రవర్తనలను రూపొందించే పర్యావరణ కారకాలను పరిశీలిస్తారు.

programme.title: శ్రీలంక - లెపర్డ్స్ ఆఫ్ యాలా
programme.sub-title: Follow the trials and tribulations of a group of leopards in Yala National Park
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు యాలాలోని చిరుతపులుల సన్నిహిత రూపాన్ని అనిందించి, వాటి ప్రవర్తనలు, మనుగడ ప్రవృత్తిని ప్రదర్శిస్తాడు.

programme.desc: Bihar KI Ramayana Yatra.

programme.title: మైండ్ వైల్డ్
programme.sub-title: Has a look at how animals build shelters that are more complicated than simple nests
programme.desc: వన్యప్రాణ నిపుణులు, వాటి సహజ ఆవాసాలలో వన్యప్రాణుల ప్రవర్తనలు, వాటి తెలివితేటల సంక్లిష్టతల గురించి వివరంగా తెలియచేస్తారు.

programme.title: బిగ్ క్యాట్స్: యాన్ అమేజింగ్ యానిమల్ ఫ్యామిలీ
programme.sub-title: As Patrick Aryee delves into the feline family tree, the biologist witnesses gravity-defying 'catrobatics', tests the speed of a cheetah, and explores the odd-looking Pallas's cat
programme.desc: ఒకజీవశాస్త్రవేత్త, అడవి ప్రాంతాన్ని పాలించే 37 రకాల పిల్లుల విజయాన్ని, వాటి వైవిధ్యమైన కుటుంబ వృక్షాన్ని వెలికితీస్తాడు.

programme.title: అటెన్‌బరోస్ లైఫ్ ఇన్ కలర్
programme.sub-title: The crew shares how they captured views of a hidden world across various habitats and challenging conditions using a pioneering camera system
programme.desc: David Attenborough explores the vital role that colour plays in the daily life of various species. For us humans, it is a source of aesthetic beauty and expression, but for animals it is an essential tool used for survival and without it, there would be catastrophic consequences. Colours help animals to win a mate, to fight off rivals and to warn enemies. Attenborough explores nature's use of colour using technological advancements in camera equipment to reveal the world, as seen by animals.

programme.title: బ్యాటిల్ ఆఫ్ ది ఆల్ఫాస్
programme.sub-title: Madagascar is home to strange animals not found anywhere else on Earth. When these animals fight for supremacy, their battles are just as strange -- from weird neck-wrestling weevils to ring-tailed lemur mums that go into battle with baby on board
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు జంతు రాజ్యంలోని వివిధ జాతుల మధ్య పోటీని డాక్యుమెంట్ చేసి, పోటీ వెనుక ఉద్దేశాలను అర్థం చేసుకుంటారు.

programme.title: బ్యాటిల్ ఆఫ్ ది ఆల్ఫాస్

programme.title: వైల్డ్ వైల్డ్ బంచ్
programme.sub-title: Killers of the wild are so lethal and dangerous that it merely requires an expression from them to make the jungle quiver and flee in fear
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు విభిన్న వన్యప్రాణుల ప్రవర్తనా, భౌతిక కోణాలను అలాగే తమ ఎరను ఓడించడానికి ఉపయోగించే వ్యూహాల గురించి తెలియజేస్తారు.

programme.title: లెపర్డ్ డైనాస్టీ: ది రైజ్ ఆఫ్ రాణా
programme.desc: In India's Jhalana Reserve, strength, strategy and survival collide in a power struggle; aging leopard Bahadur rules until his son, Rana, challenges his dominance; as father and son clash, alliances form, instincts sharpen.

programme.title: యానిమల్ ఆర్మరీ
programme.sub-title: Animals use various techniques to win a vicious brawl. While Bighorn Sheep establish mating rights by smashing their heads together, a Silverback Gorilla wrestles with the strength of 20 adult men
programme.desc: The filmmaker sheds light on how animals in the wild are equipped with natural weapons to attack, defend and hunt thus ensuring their survival.

programme.title: వైల్డ్ కింగ్డమ్స్
programme.sub-title: While rivers are the womb of a place, it is ruled by dangerous creatures like hippos, crocodiles, water monitors and fish eagles who battle relentlessly to establish supremacy
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు ప్రకృతి కాఠిన్యాన్ని భరించిన, విశాలమైన ప్రకృతి దృశ్యాలలో నివసించే కొన్ని బలమైన జంతువులను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: లయన్ క్వీన్స్: ఫైటింగ్ ఫర్ సర్వైవల్
programme.sub-title: A group of lionesses faces growing challenges as changing landscapes and rival predators threaten their survival, pushing them to adapt in new and unexpected ways
programme.desc: తమ భూభాగంలో నివసించే రుహాలోని ఆడసింహాలు భూమిని ఇతర అడవి జంతువులతో పంచుకోవలసి వచ్చినప్పుడు కొత్త వ్యూహాలు సిద్ధంచేస్తాయి.

programme.title: హిస్టరీ ఆఫ్ లైఫ్ ఆన్ ఎర్త్
programme.desc: Life evolved in the sea, in a water-bound planet, but landmasses slowly appeared, and aquatic life began to explore different ways to colonize it.

programme.title: డెసర్ట్ డైనోసార్స్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker showcases the biological ingenuity of desert animals that helps them survive in the Namib, one of the harshest places on Earth
programme.desc: భూమిపై అత్యంత కఠినమైన ప్రదేశాలలో ఒకటైన నమీబ్‌ ఎడారిలో జంతువులకు తోడ్పడే జీవసంబంధిత నైపుణ్యాన్ని ప్రదర్శిస్తారు.

programme.title: బర్త్ ఆఫ్ స్పీడ్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker traces the journey of two mother cheetahs, who strive to nurture and train their cubs to survive in the wild
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు, తమ పిల్లలను పోషించడానికి, శిక్షణ ఇవ్వడానికి ప్రయత్నించే రెండు తల్లి చిరుతల ప్రయాణాన్ని చూపుతారు.

programme.sub-title: The filmmaker delves into the search for snow leopards and records the experiences of experts who witness the rare sight of these animals moving around in rocky landscapes
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు మంచు చిరుతపులి కోసం అన్వేషిస్తూ, ఈ జంతువులు తిరిగే అరుదైన దృశ్యాన్ని చూసే నిపుణుల అనుభవాలను రికార్డు చేస్తారు.

programme.title: టైగర్ ఆన్ ది రన్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker follows a young male tiger's journey from helpless cub to confident adult as it survives alone in the wild after being forced from its territory
programme.desc: తన భూభాగం నుండి బయటికి వెళ్ళిపోయినా చిన్న మగ పులి కుమాల్, అడవిలో జీవిస్తూ, ఎలా పెరిగి, పెద్దదయ్యిందో చూడండి.

programme.title: వైల్డ్ క్యాట్స్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker explores the daily activities of predatory wild cats residing in the forests of America whilst capturing their unseen intimacy with their families
programme.desc: క్రూరమైన అడవి పిల్లులు చాలా సవాలుగా ఉన్న ప్రాంతాలలో మనుగడ కోసం పోరాడటానికి తమ అద్భుతమైన నైపుణ్యాలను ఉపయోగిస్తాయి.

programme.title: ది క్విక్ అండ్ ది స్లో
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker examines the spectrum of animal speeds and delves into the ecological factors that shape these contrasting behaviours
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు జంతువుల వేగాల వర్ణపటాన్ని పరిశీలిస్తూ, ఈ విరుద్ధమైన ప్రవర్తనలను రూపొందించే పర్యావరణ కారకాలను పరిశీలిస్తారు.

programme.title: శ్రీలంక - లెపర్డ్స్ ఆఫ్ యాలా
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker provides an intimate look at Yala's leopards, showcasing their behaviours and survival instincts in a park with one of the world's highest concentrations of these magnificent predators
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు యాలాలోని చిరుతపులుల సన్నిహిత రూపాన్ని అనిందించి, వాటి ప్రవర్తనలు, మనుగడ ప్రవృత్తిని ప్రదర్శిస్తాడు.

programme.title: వింగ్స్ ఓవర్ వాటర్
programme.desc: Wings Over Water.

programme.title: బీహార్ కీ రామాయణ యాత్ర
programme.desc: Bihar KI Ramayana Yatra.

programme.desc: Bihar KI Ramayana Yatra.

programme.title: ది వ్యూ ఫ్రమ్ ఆన్ హై
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker explores the history and architecture of the monuments and buildings in Saint Petersburg, the second-largest city in Russia
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు రష్యాలో రెండవ అతిపెద్ద నగరమైన సెయింట్ పీటర్స్‌బర్గ్‌లోని స్మారక చిహ్నాలు, భవనాల నినిర్మాణ శైలిని అన్వేషిస్తారు.

programme.title: ఎయిర్ జాస్: రెడ్, వైట్ అండ్ బ్రీచ్
programme.desc: Reports and video evidence of flying great whites off the California coast sparks a mission to capture the new phenomena on film and determine if Air Jaws has taken flight in America.

credits.actor: Jeff Kurr,Alison Towner,Andy Casagrande,Carlos Gauna,Mauricio Hoyos

programme.title: మైండ్ వైల్డ్
programme.sub-title: Explore the elements of intelligence as various animals develop wondrous strategies to create nests, safe houses, caves and other constructions
programme.desc: వన్యప్రాణ నిపుణులు, వాటి సహజ ఆవాసాలలో వన్యప్రాణుల ప్రవర్తనలు, వాటి తెలివితేటల సంక్లిష్టతల గురించి వివరంగా తెలియచేస్తారు.

programme.title: బిగ్ క్యాట్స్: యాన్ అమేజింగ్ యానిమల్ ఫ్యామిలీ
programme.sub-title: Patrick Aryee begins his American adventure in the tangled jungles of Central America, where he meets the ocelot dynasty
programme.desc: ఒకజీవశాస్త్రవేత్త, అడవి ప్రాంతాన్ని పాలించే 37 రకాల పిల్లుల విజయాన్ని, వాటి వైవిధ్యమైన కుటుంబ వృక్షాన్ని వెలికితీస్తాడు.

programme.title: అటెన్‌బరోస్ లైఫ్ ఇన్ కలర్
programme.desc: Sir David Attenborough uses innovative technology to explore how color plays a vital role in animal interactions.

programme.title: బ్యాటిల్ ఆఫ్ ది ఆల్ఫాస్
programme.sub-title: In Madagascar, the animals battle in an isolated tropical forest. Female lemurs carry their offspring for protection and hold on for dear life with panther chameleons
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు జంతు రాజ్యంలోని వివిధ జాతుల మధ్య పోటీని డాక్యుమెంట్ చేసి, పోటీ వెనుక ఉద్దేశాలను అర్థం చేసుకుంటారు.

programme.title: బ్యాటిల్ ఆఫ్ ది ఆల్ఫాస్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker documents the conflict between various species of the animal kingdom and understands the motives behind the rivalry
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు జంతు రాజ్యంలోని వివిధ జాతుల మధ్య పోటీని డాక్యుమెంట్ చేసి, పోటీ వెనుక ఉద్దేశాలను అర్థం చేసుకుంటారు.

programme.title: వైపర్ క్వీన్స్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker sheds light on the challenges faced by two snakes in different landscapes, exploring their struggles to grow and protect their families
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు రెండు పాములు వేర్వేరు ప్రకృతిదృశ్యాలలో ఎదుర్కొనే సవాళ్లను వివరిస్తారు,వారికుటుంబాలను పెంచడానికి అవి పోరాడతాయి.

programme.sub-title: Explore the elements of intelligence as various animals develop wondrous strategies to create nests, safe houses, caves and other constructions
programme.desc: వన్యప్రాణ నిపుణులు, వాటి సహజ ఆవాసాలలో వన్యప్రాణుల ప్రవర్తనలు, వాటి తెలివితేటల సంక్లిష్టతల గురించి వివరంగా తెలియచేస్తారు.

programme.title: సర్వైవింగ్ ఎర్త్
programme.desc: From the producers of Walking with Dinosaurs comes an eight-part docuseries spanning 450 million years that revisits eight of Earth's major extinction events. Bringing some of the planet's most extraordinary geological eras to vivid life, the all-new footage created in partnership with real scientific insight explores the lives of animals we know and love, including mammoths, saber-toothed cats and dinosaurs, alongside some of evolution's truly unique creatures, like gorgonopsians, pliosaurs, glyptotherium and more. Together, they tell the story of how life has endured the impossible -- and never stopped fighting for survival.

programme.title: जमाई राजा
programme.sub-title: When the wealthy Durgeshwari's daughter falls in love with Raja, a poor boy, she reluctantly agrees to their union. However, she constantly tries to sabotage their relationship, but Raja outwits her
programme.desc: अमीर दुर्गेश्वरी की बेटी, रेखा को गरीब राजा से प्यार होता है और वह उससे शादी करना चाहती है। दुर्गेश्वरी का मानना है कि उसे उससे भी अच्छा लड़का मिलेगा, इसलिए वो उन्हें अलग करने की कोशिश करती है।.

credits.actor: Hema Malini (Durgeshwari Devi),Anil Kapoor (Raja),Madhuri Dixit (Rekha),Anupam Kher (Din Dayal Trivedi),Satish Kaushik (Bankhe Bihari Chaturvedi),Shakti Kapoor (Shakti)

programme.title: सौदा
programme.sub-title: Jyoti and Deepak fall in love and get married to each other. However, due to several misunderstandings and financial troubles, they get separated
programme.desc: सामाजिक असमानता के बावजूद, ज्योति और दीपक शादी करने के बाद अलग हो जाते हैं। एक अमीर युवक प्रकाश, ज्योति का बलात्कार करने की कोशिश करता है लेकिन दीपक उसे बचा लेता है और उसे अपने प्यार का एहसास होता है।.

programme.desc: SpongeBob Schwammkopf wohnt mit seiner Schnecke Gary in der Unterwasserstadt Bikini Bottom in einer Zwei-Zimmer-Ananas und arbeitet als Krabbenburgerbrater im Fastfood-Restaurant 'Krosse Krabbe', wo Mr. Krabs sein Chef ist. Neben dem Schwammkopf ist SpongeBobs Markenzeichen die eckige Quadrathose. Seine Freunde sind Tintenfisch Thaddäus, Eichhorn Sandy und Seestern Patrick. Sein Feind ist der fiese Plankton, der an das Geheimrezept der Krabbenburger und die Weltherrschaft gelangen will. Die Serie basiert auf wahren Begebenheiten. Nun, zumindest ist ihr Erfinder Stephen Hillenburg ausgebildeter Meeresbiologe, er müsste also wissen, wie es da unten zugeht.

programme.sub-title: Muhnami 12 / Spinnen-Gericht
programme.desc: Schere, Stein und Papier wollen den zwölften Film ihrer Lieblingsreihe Muhnami sehen. Im Kuhkostüm und voller Vorfreude merken sie jedoch, dass Snacks inzwischen absurd teuer sind. Sie haben nur neun Minuten bis Filmbeginn und müssen irgendwie Snacks besorgen und rechtzeitig ins Kino kommen. Jeder versucht zu beweisen, wer der "Max Muhnami" der Gruppe ist - derjenige, der alles schafft. // Nachdem sie angeblich versucht haben, eine Spinne zu töten, landen Schere, Stein und Papier vor einem Spinnen-Gericht. Es sieht schlecht für sie aus, bis die beste Spinnenanwältin der Stadt, Veronica Web, auftaucht und ankündigt, sie zur Rechenschaft zu ziehen. Das Trio muss ihre Unschuld beweisen oder ein schreckliches Urteil erleiden.

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 7
SpongeBob SquarePants: One Coarse Meal / Gary in Love
programme.sub-title: Plankton in Panik / Schnecklich verliebt
programme.desc: Während einem weiteren Überfall Planktons auf die Krosse Krabbe taucht plötzlich Perla auf - und Mr. Krabs stellt fest, dass der Einzeller panische Angst vor Walen hat. Dies macht sich SpongeBobs Chef zunutze und versetzt seinen Erzfeind in Dauerpanik - bis sein gutherziger Angestellter ein paar Dinge ausplaudert... // Auf einem Spaziergang durch den Schneckenpark passiert es: Gary verliebt sich unsterblich. Doch auf seine angebetete Mary hat auch Bully ein Auge geworfen, eine berüchtigte Schlägerschnecke. Nun muss Gary nicht nur versuchen, die holde Mary wieder zu finden, sondern sich auch mit einem fiesen Rowdy herumschlagen - ein schneckliches Abenteuer..

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 7
SpongeBob SquarePants: The Play's the Thing / Rodeo Daze
programme.sub-title: Mit dem Essen spielt man nicht / Rodeo in Texas
programme.desc: Da Thaddäus' Theaterstück von externen Produzenten abgelehnt wurde, soll es nun in der krossen Krabbe im Rahmen eines "Singi Happa machen"-Events aufgeführt werden. Mr. Krabs stimmt allerdings nur unter der Bedingung zu, dass die Arbeit währenddessen weiter erledigt werden muss. Und so nimmt das Drama seinen Lauf - oder eher das Trauerspiel... // Als Sandy nach Texas abfliegt, um dort ihren Rodeo-Meistertitel zu verteidigen, ist SpongeBob voller Sorge: Wer weiß, welche Gefahren dort auf sie lauern? Nach einigen Rückschlägen rekrutiert er endlich halb Bikini Bottom für eine große Rettungsaktion..

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 7
SpongeBob SquarePants: Gramma's Secret Recipe / The Cent of Money
programme.sub-title: Besuch von Omama / Für eine Handvoll Kleingeld
programme.desc: Ein Besuch bei seiner Oma im Altersheim bringt Plankton auf eine geniale Idee - wer kann schon einer hilflosen Seniorin widerstehen? So gibt er sich bei SpongeBob so lange als dessen Uromama aus, bis ihn der angebliche Urenkel tatsächlich direkt zur Krabbenburger-Geheimformel bringt. Doch man unterschätze nie die Energie des Alters... // Als Mr. Krabs sieht, dass Gary Münzen tatsächlich magnetisch anzieht, gibt es kein Halten mehr für ihn. Während er SpongeBob mit langwierigen Arbeiten beschäftigt hält, plündert er ohne Rücksicht auf Verluste, und vor allem ohne Rücksicht auf Gary, die Kleingeldvorräte größerer Teile der örtlichen Bevölkerung. Als ihm SpongeBob endlich auf die Schliche kommt, bahnt sich bereits ein größeres Unheil an..

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 7
SpongeBob SquarePants: The Monster Who Came to Bikini Bottom / Welcome to the Bikini Bottom Triangle
programme.sub-title: Monsterbesuch in Bikini Bottom / Willkommen im Bikini-Bottom-Dreieck
programme.desc: Zufällig begegnet Patrick einem riesigen Monster. Schnell freunden sich die beiden an. Auch SpongeBob ist die Kreatur sympathisch; nur dessen Art, mit den Wohnstätten seiner Spielkameraden umzugehen, stößt, nun ja, nicht auf ungeteilten Beifall. Schließlich muss das Monster die Stadt verlassen, findet aber dank SpongeBob dennoch seine Bestimmung... // SpongeBob und seinen Freunden kommen auf ungeklärte Art immer mehr Besitztümer abhanden. Bald zieht ein gespenstischer Nebel auf, der geheimnisvolle Gesang der Meerjungfrauen hebt an, und -schwupps! - findet man sich im Bikini-Bottom-Dreieck wieder. Also dort, wo nichts und niemand mehr wegkommt. Was tun.

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 7
SpongeBob SquarePants: The Curse of the Hex / The Main Drain
programme.sub-title: Der Fluch des Banns / Kein Meer mehr
programme.desc: Hartherzig verweigert Mr. Krabs einer seltsamen alten Dame einen Krabbenburger zum ermäßigten Preis. Die belegt daraufhin die Krosse Krabbe mit einem Fluch. Tatsächlich blieben von Stund an die Gäste aus und allerlei Unfälle ereignen sich. Um den Bann zu lösen, müssen Mr. Krabs und SpongeBob nun eine gefährliche Aufgabe erfüllen... // Mr. Krabs erzählt SpongeBob und Patrick die schauerliche Geschichte des Hauptablassstopfens, den einst zwei Kinder im Spiel zogen und damit die ganze Unterwasserwelt in den Abgrund rissen. Vor allem Patrick will nun unbedingt diesen Ablassstopfen finden. Warum wohl.

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 7
SpongeBob SquarePants: Trenchbillies / Sponge-Cano
programme.sub-title: Hinterdeichler / Sponge-Kan
programme.desc: Beim Quallenfischen fallen SpongeBob und Patrick eine Klippe herunter und landen unter einer Sippe von tiefsten Hinterdeichlern. Obwohl sich unsere Helden tapfer schlagen, was örtliche Sitten und Gebräuche angeht, hilft irgendwann nur noch die Flucht - und nicht einmal die... // Einmal mehr fließt SpongeBob schier über vor Zufriedenheit und Dankbarkeit, und einmal mehr geht er seinem Nachbarn Thaddäus damit gewaltig auf die Nerven. Einmal mehr bittet der den kleinen Schwamm darum, ihm nie mehr zu helfen - und einmal mehr muss Thaddäus diese Bitte, Aug in Aug mit der Katastrophe, diesmal in Gestalt eines ausbrechenden Vulkans, zurücknehmen..
